text:
Maya Chen: Flagging a small but important UX issue in the rotate key modal. When users only edit metadata (name/role) the red warning still appears. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/key-rotate-v2
Samir Patel: Yep. That banner reads like an emergency. It should only be primary when the old key will be revoked. Right now it makes users think rotate == revoke.
Jamie Ortiz: Accessibility: screen reader users only hear the modal title; the big visual banner is skipped. We should add an aria-live region for any danger text, and ensure focus order announces the banner when applicable.
Kevin Liu: API note: rotation returns something like {"rotated": true, "old_key_revoked": false} which we can keep. We can add a `revoke_old_key` boolean option to the rotation API and wire a toggle in the UI.
Aria Gomez: For copy, how about a checkbox label: "Revoke existing key after rotation (recommended if you suspect compromise)" Leave unchecked by default but show a short explanation.
Samir Patel: Banner copy is ambiguous now: "This will revoke access". Suggest clearer text: "Revoking the old key immediately stops services using it from authenticating." Short alert: "Old key remains active unless revoked."
Jamie Ortiz: Keyboard flow: when modal opens focus should land on the first input (name). If revoke toggle is enabled and the user changes it, we should move focus to the aria-live alert so it's announced. Escape should close and return focus to the key row.
Kevin Liu: Operationally we want to avoid accidental mass outages. Proposed flow: default revoke = off. If user toggles revoke -> show inline red summary and then a second confirm step on submit: small dialog "Revoke old key now? This will immediately cut off services." The extra confirm prevents accidental revokes.
Maya Chen: UX approach: keep primary CTA non-danger unless revoke is selected. Show contextual inline banner directly under the toggle when checked, not a full modal-wide red banner for metadata-only edits. Also add a tiny "When to revoke?" help link that opens docs about rollout windows and staggered deploys.
Samir Patel: Also update audit logs text to include "revoked_by" and timestamp so SREs can trace incidents.
Jamie Ortiz: I'll update Figma to show: 1) checkbox toggle placement, 2) aria-live container, 3) confirm dialog copy, 4) keyboard tab order.
ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-1299: "Rotate modal: revoke toggle + accessible alerts + copy updates" assigned to @Jamie, @Kevin, @Samir. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-1299
Kevin Liu: I'll add feature-flagged `revoke_old_key` param and a guard in the backend. Will draft PR and link it to PROD-1299.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. Quick follow-up: can design & eng sync on acceptance criteria before implementation? Want to avoid multiple rounds of copy/ux churn. :smile:
